title: DepEd, Manila sign ₱3.3-B pact for Tondo school building project

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The City of Manila and the Department of Education (DepEd) have signed a P3.307-billion agreement to rebuild Jose P. Rizal Elementary School in Tondo. Manila Mayor Francisco “Isko” Moreno” Domagoso and Education Secretary Sonny Angara led the signing of the agreement on Monday, which covers the construction of a 10-storey school building and a six-storey midrise structure. The project aims to modernize the school’s facilities, improve the learning environment and end its double-shift classes.
